method: Individual original-image inspection through vision_analyze: four smoke PNGs and standalone marketing.webp per ID. Prior partial-ledger.json and visual-1.json read for context; prior board findings not substituted for original inspection.
disposition_definition: pass is a bounded visual candidate disposition, not final user approval or release authorization. needs-decision denotes an unresolved visible presentation/fidelity concern, not necessarily broken geometry. review_complete means all five required images inspected, not all technical acceptance gates passed.
limitations: Static endpoints cannot establish motion clearance, hidden topology, physical hinge contact, collision, or source/model parity. No Blender inspection or fresh browser execution performed.
Marketing images are promotional illustrations, not exact-model ground truth, and show only the closed exterior. Different lighting, scale and camera angle limit exact comparisons.
Mobile evidence is an emulated viewport, not a physical-phone test. Fine hardware contact and cavity bottoms remain partly occluded.
Released clasps and exterior ornaments hidden by raised lids are not classified as failures. Dark closure seams also appear in the marketing references.
No final approval, mint/release authorization, or change to historical holds is implied. Prior reports and all source art remain unchanged.

findings.reason: Bounded visual candidate pass: coherent terrain chest, intact visible open cavity and complete desktop/mobile framing; no unequivocal structural defect observed.
finish_and_fidelity_differences: Viewer banding is more repetitive and orange/ochre; marketing surfaces and terrain contours read softer and rounder.
Terrain and rock-like feet are more angular in the viewer. Muted brass fittings and broad terrain arrangement preserve the reference identity.
geometry_observations: Prominent dark closed seam occurs in both viewer and marketing; it does not prove failed closure.

Desktop closed shows a small stepped light detail under the front-left lid and a distinct vertical panel/bevel boundary. Open rim joints look stepped in places, without a demonstrated hole or detached part.
Both open screenshots show a coherent recess, raised patterned lid and visible rear hardware. Entire object, feet and projecting clasp fit all four frames.
limitations: Fine rim and hinge contact unresolved from static view; no mechanical-fit certification.
Cavity floor is partly obscured. Finish differences are not geometry failures.

findings.reason: Original inspection is complete and no definite structural failure is visible, but lid ornament fidelity needs an explicit decision: viewer reads as leafy botanical relief whereas marketing reads as a more angular radial/petal medallion.
finish_and_fidelity_differences: Closed viewer medallion contains recognizable leaf/stem shapes within a double ring; standalone marketing has a more angular radial/petal layout. This is an ornament-fidelity difference, not missing geometry.
Viewer copper is orange and graphically mottled, with comparatively angular satin brass feet and clasp. Marketing has richer brown grain, softer shading and more pronounced relief/highlights.
geometry_observations: Closed body, lid, corner fittings and visible block feet remain coherent in desktop and mobile.
Open cavity reads hollow with visible inner walls. Rim joins are stepped and hinge seating partly obscured; no definite detachment, inverted wall or hole is established.
All four views fully frame the chest and hardware. Dark closure band also exists in marketing.
findings.next_decision: Decide whether the observed medallion/finish difference is acceptable for the candidate; do not edit art or infer that marketing defines exact geometry.
limitations: Different view/lighting prevents exact ornament equivalence certification.
No open marketing reference; hidden exterior ornament and released clasp are not defects. Hinge contact and cavity floor remain unresolved.

findings.reason: Bounded visual candidate pass: two roofed towers, smaller open cylindrical feature, connected architecture and earthen chest identity retained. No definite geometry or framing failure in the required views.
finish_and_fidelity_differences: Viewer roofs are more simplified/faceted with radial or stippled texture; marketing thatch shows finer repeated radial and horizontal detail.
Viewer terracotta is warmer orange and relatively flat in shading; marketing is peachier with richer surface/contact treatment and more reflective fittings.
The central circular opening and narrow front recess are present, but their depth reads less strongly than in marketing.
geometry_observations: Both closed views show the tower arrangement, pale conical roofs, short feet and front fittings; broad dark seam is also present in marketing.
Open views show intact visible cavity walls, rim and lid inner face; no demonstrated missing faces or broken hardware.
Full original desktop and mobile layouts include header, object and controls without obvious clipping; prior board-header concern is not reproduced in the originals.
limitations: Roof texture/opening depth not certified at these display scales.
Hidden exterior architecture in open pose is not missing; rear attachment and cavity bottom remain partly occluded.

findings.reason: Bounded visual candidate pass: architectural lid motif, cream trim/feet and brass identity retained; no definite broken geometry, missing visible feature or framing defect.
finish_and_fidelity_differences: Viewer is warmer terracotta with more angular/beveled detailing; marketing is softer peach/salmon with rounded cream feet and roof caps.
Both retain three capped architectural forms, low courtyard rails, cream panel stripes, dark front accents, front clasp/disc and side ring. Metallic and contact shading is richer in marketing.
geometry_observations: Closed seam is continuous and dark in both viewer and reference, not demonstrated fracture or closure failure.
Open cavity, raised lid, visible hinges and rim are coherent in desktop/mobile; no definite hole, stray obstruction or broken section.
All four screenshots contain the full chest, feet and raised hardware without obvious clipping.
limitations: Rear/underside details and a concealed foot cannot be verified.
Static endpoint evidence does not certify hinge connectivity or movement; concealed lid ornaments are not failures.

findings.reason: Original inspection is complete. Open mobile framing reveals conspicuously stepped/offset rim junctions, especially rear-right, which warrant a presentation-quality decision or closer alternate-angle review. Apparent hinge separation is uncertain, not proven breakage.

observed_defects.observation: Cavity rim has conspicuous corner discontinuities, especially rear-right: pale end pieces and offset dark strips make the joint read unfinished.
observed_defects.certainty: Visible presentation concern; unintended geometry, missing material and mechanical failure are not established.

finish_and_fidelity_differences: Viewer terrain is warmer tan/rust with sharper regular facets, whereas marketing peaks are grayer and more granular. Both preserve the lower left mass, taller rear-right peak and cracked white salt patch on a pale slab.

Viewer body waves are pronounced and repetitive; marketing has softer salmon coloring, stronger metallic highlights and richer grounding. Short rounded feet and front/side fittings retain the reference identity.
geometry_observations: Closed desktop/mobile show no definite broken component; salt-basin polygonal lines are intentional detail, not cracks in the model.
Open desktop shows hinge barrels apparently separated from the rear rim, but concealed connecting structure cannot be resolved. This is not a finding of a broken or detached hinge.
Visible cavity walls and lid are intact; all four screenshots fully frame the object and controls. Released clasp and obscured terrain are not defects.
findings.next_decision: Resolve whether open-rim presentation is acceptable or requires a separate closer inspection. Keep hinge-contact uncertainty and terrain/finish differences separate from confirmed geometry defects.
limitations: No alternate-angle or motion inspection to resolve apparent hinge contact/rim construction.
Closed-only marketing cannot establish interior fidelity; cavity floor partly hidden. No art changes authorized or made.
